security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-src 'none'; img-src 'self' data: blob: tiles: http://tiles.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A proposed picture of the ground, built from StrataField's borewell records
bundle.longDescription: Shows what the ground is probably made of anywhere in the city, worked out from the borewells recorded in StrataField. Reads StrataField's records and never changes them.
